correctness.rationale: The uncovered-vertex lemma exhausts all feasible supports. Essential-edge tests prove the four disjoint types, with the single-missing-value singleton-preimage condition explicitly checked. Inclusion–exclusion of prohibited matching edges gives the star-forest EGF, since disjoint forced edges must inhabit distinct star components. All all-n bounds follow by component sizes. The independent edge-neighborhood brute-force verifier checked 1,052,740 subsets for n=2..5, and exact EGF/forest checks agree. Finite tests do not establish the unbounded theorem; the proof does.

value.rationale: The complete cardinality distribution of inclusion-minimal edge domination on the natural crown family is motivated by enumerating all minimal solutions, not only minimum matchings. The exact support classification reveals restricted endofunctions and paired star forests, yields sharp lower/upper multiplicities, and quantifies loss of the well-edge-dominated property after deleting one perfect matching. These are substantial natural structural facts beyond direct scalar bounds.
